bakers_stall.name: Baker's stall
bakers_stall.examine: Loaves of panis quadratus, still warm.

cloth_stall.name: Cloth stall
cloth_stall.examine: Bolts of Gallic linen and coarse wool.

silversmiths_stall.name: Silversmith's stall
silversmiths_stall.examine: Brooches and rings, under the silversmith's eye.

spice_stall.name: Spice stall
spice_stall.examine: Pepper from India, by the spoonful. It costs more than the silver it's weighed against.

jewellers_stall.name: Jeweller's stall
jewellers_stall.examine: Pearls from the Red Sea and gold from Dacia, under the jeweller's nose.

townsman.name: Townsman
townsman.examine: A townsman of Castra Ferrea. His purse hangs loose.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.examine: A Gaulish merchant with rings on every finger.

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.examine: A dice player from the Subura's taverns, flush tonight. It won't last.

senator.name: Senator
senator.examine: A senator on his way to the curia, with a slave carrying his purse. The purse is the easy part.

warehouse_strongbox.name: Warehouse strongbox
warehouse_strongbox.examine: A shipping agent's iron-bound box, chained to the floor.

procurators_strongbox.name: Procurator's strongbox
procurators_strongbox.examine: The mine's pay chest. The procurator trusts the lock more than his clerks.

merchants_strongbox.name: Merchant's strongbox
merchants_strongbox.examine: Nikias's own coffer, with a lock from Corinth and a needle in it.

insula_strongbox.name: Insula strongbox
insula_strongbox.examine: The landlord's rent box, at the foot of the stairs. Five storeys of tenants have paid into it.

senators_strongbox.name: Senator's strongbox
senators_strongbox.examine: A senator's arca, bronze over oak, chained to the atrium floor. There's a dog painted on the threshold: cave canem.
